name: Rename VAT to GST for WooCommerce
author: Abhi

sections.description:
Many countries like Australia, Canada, Singapore and India use GST instead of VAT. This plugin automatically renames VAT and Tax labels to GST across your entire WooCommerce store.

Works everywhere:
* Cart & Checkout pages
* Order confirmation pages
* Email notifications
* Admin order pages
* My Account pages

Features:
* ✅ Zero configuration needed
* ✅ Compatible with WooCommerce HPOS
* ✅ Works with all WooCommerce themes
* ✅ Lightweight and performant
* ✅ Follows WordPress coding standards
sections.installation:
1. Install from WordPress Plugin Directory or upload the plugin files
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. That’s it! GST labels will appear automatically
sections.faq:
Does this work with the latest WooCommerce?

Yes, tested up to WooCommerce 10.3.5 and supports HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage).

Do I need to configure anything?

No configuration needed. Activate and it works immediately.

Does it work with multilingual sites?

Yes, it works with translated WooCommerce strings.
